title: Cut data upload cycles from 20 minutes to 2
summary: Modernized legacy batch pipelines for high-volume financial data ingestion. Replaced monolithic SSIS workflows with event-driven microservices on AKS, enabling parallel processing and real-time validation.
bullets: Redesigned ETL architecture from sequential batch to streaming microservices, reducing upload time 10x
Built REST APIs for pipeline orchestration and monitoring with Spring Boot
Implemented Iceberg and Delta Lake formats for incremental data processing
Integrated Databricks for analytics workloads with automated schema evolution

title: Reduced operational overhead 25% with automated recovery
summary: Built the Automated Recovery Tool (ART) for telecom service provisioning. When workflows failed, ART diagnosed the cause, retried safe operations, and escalated unrecoverable errors—cutting manual intervention by a quarter.
bullets: Designed fault-tolerant recovery engine for provisioning workflows
Implemented intelligent retry logic with exponential backoff and circuit breakers
Built diagnostic engine to classify failure types and suggest remediation
Reduced manual operations overhead by 25% through automation

title: Production-grade homelab for continuous learning
summary: Self-hosted infrastructure for testing new technologies and maintaining personal services. Runs containerized applications, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring stack, and network services on dedicated hardware.
bullets: Deployed Kubernetes cluster with GitOps workflows using ArgoCD
Self-hosted CI/CD with Drone and private container registry
Implemented observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki
Network services: Pi-hole DNS, reverse proxy, VPN gateway
